aiadvice.title: AI Investment Advice
aiadvice.subtitle: Buy candidates and sell rationale derived from real news/announcement AI analysis, with quoted evidence
aiadvice.emptyBuy: No buy candidates: no recent positive AI analysis with L2+ materiality linked to a listed stock.
aiadvice.emptyHold: No paper positions, or quotes unavailable for the held stock.
aiadvice.disclaimer: For research assistance only, based on public news/announcements and local rules. Not investment advice. Data may be delayed or unlicensed; verify original sources.

tradeplan.title: Trade Plan & One-Week Simulation
tradeplan.subtitle: AI provides entry, take-profit, stop-loss, quantity and position size; simulation starts next trading day and settles after 5 real trading days
tradeplan.noPlans: No plan yet. Click “Build trade plan”.
tradeplan.disclaimer: Plans are generated from AI advice + market regime + rules. The simulation uses only future real data and never fabricates results. Not investment advice.
tradeplan.relationHint: AI Advice = research conclusions; Trade Plan = converts executable BUY/SELL into prices and quantities (HOLD gets no plan); Paper Trading = where you manually place virtual orders; plans never execute automatically.
tradeplan.relationNote: Positions in Paper Trading come from your earlier manual paper orders and do not auto-sync with this page.
tradeplan.stale: ⚠ Advice is newer than the plan; regenerate the plan
tradeplan.holdNoPlan: No action needed (HOLD has no plan)

pipeline.title: AI Paper Trading (full pipeline)
pipeline.subtitle: Collect news/announcements → AI analysis → stocks with trading room → paper trading → real one-week result
pipeline.step1Hint: Running the pipeline fetches the latest announcements/news; existing data is kept.
pipeline.step2Hint: AI extracts sentiment, materiality, stock links and verbatim evidence.
pipeline.noOpportunity: No actionable opportunity now (wait for a stronger market or new information).
pipeline.step3Hint: WATCH=room exists but not executed now; READY=executable; SELL_NOW=sell/reduce holding.
pipeline.step4Hint: Simulation account is separate from your manual paper account; it tracks plans with market filters.
pipeline.weekPending: Requires 5 future trading days of real data; no return is shown before settlement.
pipeline.disclaimer: Research simulation only, not investment advice; data may be delayed/unlicensed.
